validity.researcher_notes: The sources name Gazprom as the developer. The tender customer is Gazprom Proektirovanie, a Gazprom design company. No page links Sonatrach, an Algerian company, to a Volodino to Krasnoyarsk pipeline. The existing ref for the owner is a Sonatrach tariff document.

fills.researcher_notes: No page names a future operator. The pipeline is only planned. Only the wiki citations were read this pass and no web search was done.

Two reports name Gazprom as the developer. A November 2023 TASS report quotes the deputy prime minister saying Gazprom is surveying a pipeline of about 700 km from Tomsk Oblast to Krasnoyarsk. An October 2024 report on the gasification roadmap says Gazprom is preparing the design of the trunk pipeline. No page names Sonatrach. The sheet value Sonatrach has only a Sonatrach tariff document as its ref. This proposes Gazprom PJSC, the developer, in place of Sonatrach. No page says who will hold the pipe once built.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Latest dated sources are an October 2024 roadmap and a November 2023 report. Both give 2028 for first gas to Krasnoyarsk and say design and surveys are underway. The newest source is about two years old. Nothing says the project is shelved, and the work reported was recent for a project this size, so proposed stays. A later pass should look for 2025 and 2026 news.
